description: Land Title Settlement Department - Uswetakeiyawa, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512037 (22/0774)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining title to multiple land parcels (numbers 93-142) in a specific geographic location, including detailed parcel information, ownership details (all owned by "The State"), and land classification. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it involves land registration, title determination, and property ownership matters.
